description: This file defines dependencies and types for a Telegram bot extension within the openclaw project, primarily managing imports of plugin SDK functions and establishing dependency injection via the TelegramBotDeps type and its default implementation.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Function to load configuration settings for the bot.

methods.name: resolveStorePath
methods.description: Function to resolve storage paths for bot data.

methods.name: loadSessionStore
methods.description: Optional function to load session data.

methods.name: readChannelAllowFromStore
methods.description: Function to read channel permissions from store.

methods.name: upsertChannelPairingRequest
methods.description: Function to insert or update channel pairing requests.

methods.name: buildModelsProviderData
methods.description: Function to build models provider data.

methods.name: dispatchReplyWithBufferedBlockDispatcher
methods.description: Function to dispatch replies with buffering.

methods.name: listSkillCommandsForAgents
methods.description: Function to list commands for agent skills.

methods.name: loadWebMedia
methods.description: Optional function to load web media.

methods.name: syncTelegramMenuCommands
methods.description: Optional function to sync Telegram menu commands.

methods.name: wasSentByBot
methods.description: Function to determine if a message was sent by the bot.

methods.name: resolveTelegramExecApproval
methods.description: Optional function to resolve Telegram execution approvals.

methods.name: createTelegramDraftStream
methods.description: Optional function to create a draft stream for Telegram messages.

methods.name: deliverReplies
methods.description: Optional function to deliver reply messages.

methods.name: emitInternalMessageSentHook
methods.description: Optional function to emit message sent hooks.

methods.name: editMessageTelegram
methods.description: Optional function to edit Telegram messages.
